summary: Anheuser-Busch InBev SA/NV filed a Form 6-K furnishing amended articles of association following a shareholder meeting on April 29, 2026. The filing includes a coordinated text of the company's articles reflecting amendments made at that meeting. No terms, prices, stakes, premiums, or dates are provided as this is a routine corporate governance update. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing is a foreign private issuer report incorporating the amended articles by reference into existing registration statements. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation event. What to watch: none, as this is a standard post-meeting filing with no transactional or strategic event.
